_comment: Sites and the recorders deployed at them. A site is a PLACE; a deployment is a
recorder listening there, with its own audio folder. Two boxes at one place are two
deployments of one site - never two sites, because the location's history has to stay
This is the single source of truth for run.ps1 and the local web app, so coordinates,
timezone and recorder id are stated once instead of being retyped as flags (and
mistyped: a wrong recorder silently mis-parses filenames or shifts every solar time).
Recorder ids must exist in dawnchorus/recorders.py.
Audio folders are gitignored; only detections and the site JSON are ever published.
`audio` may be an ABSOLUTE path, which is how recordings live on a big external
drive while the repo stays on the system disk -- a card dump is several GB. Each
folder carries its own results/ and manifest.json, so a deployment moves as a unit;
repointing `audio` without moving those makes it look unprocessed and re-runs it all.

`exclusions` per site removes known non-bird sources: a date, the species it was misread as, and why. Curated by hand on purpose -- a huge spike can also be a real event, so nothing is dropped automatically. Excluded counts are printed at build time and carried in payload meta, never applied silently.

sm.note: Original box. 1-hour files, dawn-relative schedule. Baseline since 2026-07-25.

owl.note: Trial box, co-located with sm on 2026-08-06/07. 2-hour files. Scores ~0.1 lower confidence than the Song Meter (species-dependent), so its detections are NOT composition-comparable with sm - see tools/compare_recorders.py.

exclusions.reason: Rain on an upturned bucket produced a continuous percussive plink for ~4 hours. 1,005 Wild Turkey detections against a median of 0 on other mornings, at a median 3.0s gap; the same sound also read as woodpecker drumming. Bucket has since been turned over.
